title: T2-T3 ROM inside C7-L2 rib cage specimen, post-CL, no ribs (rib heads removed) (Rahm 2019)

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: segmental rotation range at +/-5 Nm (full range), 3rd cycle, Optotrak

source.authors: Rahm MD, Brooks DM, Harris JA, Hart RA, Hughes JL, Ferrick BJ, Bucklen BS
source.sample: 5 fresh-frozen human C7-L2 spines with intact rib cage incl. intercostal muscles

protocol.summary: C7-L2 with intact rib cage potted at C7 and L2; quasi-static pure moments +/-5 Nm at 1.5 deg/s, 3 cycles (3rd analysed), FE/LB/AR; then T4-L2 instrumentation, 18000 FE cycles, stepwise rib removal.
how_to_simulate: Model C7-L2 with full rib cage (incl. intercostal muscles); fix L2
Add bilateral T4-L2 pedicle screw-rod construct and the rib reduction of this step
Apply pure moments +/-5 Nm at C7, no preload
protocol.notes: T4-T5 and T5-T6 are instrumented after step 0; only the intact baseline is extracted for them.

extraction.check_notes: Re-read from text layer; intact T4-T5/T5-T6 also stated in Results text (1.8/2.5/2.9, 1.3/1.5/2.4).

sequence: T4-L2 pedicle screw-rod instrumentation, ribs intact, pre cyclic loading
post cyclic loading (18000 cycles +/-5 Nm FE), rib cage intact
post-CL, ribs cut 3 cm lateral to the costovertebral joints (partial ribs)
